pages.raw_meta: General information about Intuit including our history, values, corporate responsibility initiatives, partners, supplier programs, and more.
raw_blocks: Serving tens of millions of customers worldwide with TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Intuit Enterprise Suite, Intuit helps put more money in consumers’ and small businesses’ pockets, saving them time by eliminating work, and ensuring they have confidence in every financial decision they make.
Intuit believes everyone should have the opportunity to prosper and we never stop working to find new innovative ways to make that possible.
Intuit’s impact by the numbers

The work of powering prosperity goes beyond our products. Around the world people struggle to make ends meet. Economic opportunity is still not available to all. And climate change is having an oversized impact on distressed communities. At Intuit, we’re committed to using our unique position to find ways to power prosperity, especially for those that need it most.
Explore careers at Intuit and find a team where your work moves people forward.
Get to know our operating values and the principles that guide how we work.
